content: We have carbon NMR data: chemical shifts list. Need number of CH3 groups (methyl). Methyl carbons typically around 10-30 ppm for aliphatic, but here we have 43.47 and 38.60. Those could be CH2 or CH3 attached to something. Need to determine which are methyl. Could also use proton NMR to see methyl signals. Let's get proton NMR.
